## The athlete in motion

::: {.bio}
[[Gu Eon Kang](https://be.utdallas.edu/people/faculty/gu-eon-kang/)]{.name} [Active]{.tag}<br>[Bioengineering · [Neuromuscular & Musculoskeletal Biomechanics Lab](https://labs.utdallas.edu/nmbl/)]{.dept}

Baseball biomechanics with **UT Dallas Baseball** and DFW training centers. Return-to-sport jump/landing analysis after ACL reconstruction with **Texas Health Resources Sports Medicine**.

::: {.card .person}

::: {.bio}
[[Liang He](https://profiles.utdallas.edu/liang.he)]{.name} [Active]{.tag}<br>[Computer Science]{.dept}

[**AgentCoach**](https://engineering.purdue.edu/cdesign/wp/agentcoach/) (CHI 2026): AI that turns tutorial videos into movement evaluation and adaptive coaching feedback, validated on sports and exercise videos.
:::
:::

::: {.card .person}
![](contents/assets/faculty/zhou.jpg){.headshot}

::: {.bio}
[[Hao Zhou](https://hzhou3.github.io/)]{.name} [Emerging]{.tag .emerging}<br>[Computer Science · [Human-Aware Intelligence Lab](https://hzhou3.github.io/hai/)]{.dept}

Full-body **muscle activation from insole pressure sensors** (MobiCom 2026); smart rings, earbuds, physiological sensing. Athlete monitoring is a natural next step.
:::
:::

::: {.card .person}
![](contents/assets/faculty/kehtarnavaz.jpg){.headshot}

[[Nasser Kehtarnavaz](https://personal.utdallas.edu/~kehtar/)]{.name} [Earlier work]{.tag .earlier}<br>[Electrical & Computer Eng. · [Embedded Machine Learning Lab](https://ece.utdallas.edu/research/facilities/signal-and-image-processing-sip-laboratory/)]{.dept}

[**UTD-MHAD**](https://personal.utdallas.edu/~kehtar/UTD-MHAD.html) (2015): camera + wearable inertial sensing that recognizes basketball shots, baseball swings, tennis strokes, squats.
